rejections.claim: HYPOTHESIS: every per-game source before 2007-08 descends from the NHL API or Hockey-Reference (itself from HSP), so two sources agreeing is one source twice
rejections.reason: Partly rejected. Two independent lineages exist for pre-1987 games: (1) the NHL's own league-office archive, digitized for the 2017 centennial and served by the NHL API (NHL_DB, any self-pull); (2) the volunteer HSP. Hockey-Reference is not simply HSP downstream: it credits Dan Diamond and Associates (licensed) for much data and HSP only for some game scores and sweater numbers. The hypothesis holds for 1987-88..2009-10 third-party per-game files (all NHL API pulls) and for NHLData (HR).
